Earth Science
Earth Science
The UCSB Earth Science graduate program, ranked among the best in the country, offers Masters or Ph.D. degrees in Earth Science in a variety of areas of specialization, plus three optional doctoral emphases and an optional certificate in university teaching. Research areas include geochemistry, geomorphology and Quaternary geology, geophysics, paleobiology, geobiology, paleoclimate, petrology, sedimentology and stratigraphy, structural geology and crustal evolution, volcanology, seismology and tectonics.
Our goal as a graduate program is to provide students with an unparalleled academic experience, preparing them for their future roles as independent researchers, teachers, and scholars by participation in innovative research alongside our distinguished faculty. With a lower graduate student/faculty ratio (2/1) than the other top-10 Earth Science programs, we provide a remarkable level of individual support and guidance to each graduate student. Admitted students are typically fully supported throughout the duration of their degree Program (2 years for MS, 5 years for PhD).
